accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, canvas widgets, plc items, tag rows, and alarm toggles MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.

3d_libraries.canvas_engine: HTML5 Canvas / SVG rendering for widgets, Lucide React icons for controls, Recharts for trend charts and history trends.

instructions_to_main_agent.app_overview: Aplikasi Builder SCADA / HMI web berbasis React dengan Bahasa Indonesia, tema Gelap ala Software Industri. Mendukung manajemen koneksi PLC (S7-1200/1500, S7-200, Wecon, Omron FINS, Haiwell, Weintek, Modbus TCP), Tag Manager dengan kalkulasi otomatis panjang karakter & decimal berdasarkan tipe data (INT16, UINT16, INT32, UINT32, FLOAT32, BOOL), Drag & Drop HMI Builder dengan komponen intuitif, serta Publish Web App Runtime URL publik untuk client.
key_features_to_implement: 2. Dashboard Proyek SCADA (Buat proyek baru, daftar proyek, hapus, buka editor, publish URL).
3. Connection & Driver Manager (Pilih protokol Siemens S7-1200/1500, S7-200, Wecon, Omron FINS, Haiwell, Weintek, Modbus TCP, IP, Port, Rack/Slot, Toggle Simulator vs Real Driver).

4. Tag Manager: Tambah/edit tag PLC. Pilihan tipe data (INT16, UINT16, INT32, UINT32, FLOAT32, BOOL). Kalkulasi otomatis Maksimum Panjang Karakter (contoh: INT16 -> max 6 char '-32768', UINT16 -> max 5 char '65535', FLOAT32 -> max 12 char) & opsi mengatur Decimal Point otomatis/manual. Alarm limits (HH, High, Low, LL).

5. Visual HMI Builder Editor: Canvas drag & drop + resize + snap to grid. Multi-screen tabs (Screen 1 Main, Screen 2 Tank, Screen 3 Alarm). Top bar with Undo, Redo, Grid Toggle, Save, Preview, Publish. Widget palette di kiri & Property Inspector di kanan.

6. Intuitive SCADA Widgets: Button/Switch (Momentary, Toggle, Set Value), Status Lamp/LED, Numeric Display, Numeric Input/Setpoint, Slider, Radial/Linear Gauge, Liquid Tank / Level Bar, Real-time Trend Chart (Recharts), History Trend, Alarm Record Table (ISA-18.2 severity colors), Data Record Table, Label/Text (Custom font/color/size), Shapes (Rectangle, Circle, Line, Pipe), Import Photo/SVG asset.

7. Public Runtime Viewer: Halaman publik via URL unik (/runtime/:projectId atau /view/:publishId), mode full-screen, live values via WebSocket/polling simulator, kontrol interaktif (operate) untuk sakelar/setpoint.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide React icons (@lucide-react or lucide-react).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
